messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert - P1 for dedicated tenant 'clearwave' (tenant_id: cq-47). 5xx rate spike and rising queuelength. Auto-escalating.
PagerDuty: triggered INC-20260315-77 -> paging SRE Rotation
SRE Rotation: ack
Alex Chen: I'm joining. seeing intermittent 503s from runtime nodes in cq-47. error = upstream allocate failed.
Maria Gomez: dashboards: 5xx rate 11% over 3m, median latency 1.8s -> p95 3.9s. KV cache evictions up 4x. Queues building on frontend of service.
Jamie Patel: checking autoscaler - desired replicas > available; GKE nodepool can't spin due to GPU quota soft-limit. cloud console shows 'Quota exceeded: GPUs'
Alex Chen: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T01:12:33Z] runtime: serve request id=req-8a1 503 allocate tensor failed: out-of-memory
[2026-03-15T01:12:34Z] kvcache: evict shard=shard-41 reason=memory-pressure
```
Maria Gomez: customer impact: Clearwave embeddings and chat routes return 503 intermittently. Support ticket #SUP-876 marked impacted (75% of traffic for clearwave embeddings affected).
Alex Chen: short-term mitigations: 1) enable model fallback route to 'clearwave-fallback-small' in routing policy (reduces mem). 2) throttle low-priority requests for tenant. 3) clear KV prefix cache to free memory (careful stateful).
Jamie Patel: I can open quota increase request but ETA ~20-40m. Ops can temporarily increase burst capacity if we approve.
SRE Rotation: applying routing change now -> /routing/tenant/cq-47 -> fallback=true
Support Bot: notified Clearwave account team and created scheduled update: ETA 30m
Maria Gomez: applying throttle rule: rate-limit embeddings for cq-47 to 2rps per-token. Doing config push.
Alex Chen: pushing config:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-config/api/v1/tenants/cq-47/policies \
 -d '{"routing":{"fallback_model":"clearwave-fallback-small"}, "throttle":{"embeddings_rps":2}}'
```
SRE Rotation: config push succeeded. Monitoring for 5xx drop.
Alex Chen: immediate effect: 5xx down to 3% in 2m, latency p95 down to 2.1s. Still seeing occasional OOMs on node-7.
Jamie Patel: node-7 shows repeated allocation failures, underlying GPU driver crashed and restarted container. I'm draining node-7 and cordoning.
Theo Rivera: I'll take the handoff in 30m for post-fix monitoring. leaving notes: quota req in progress, fallback routing live, throttle applied, customer updated.
SRE Rotation: escalation path: if 5xx >5% again -> PD escalates to SRE lead and exec.
Alex Chen: summary for handoff: impacted tenant = Clearwave (cq-47), root cause = resource exhaustion on dedicated GPU pool due to KV cache growth + sudden traffic spike, mitigations = routing fallback, throttle, node drain, quota request, next steps = follow quota and remove throttle when capacity restored.
Maria Gomez: tagging for postmortem and Eval regression check for fallback quality. @Support Bot please track SLA hits.
Support Bot: acknowledged, created PM ticket PM-20260315-clearwave-503
Theo Rivera: ack taking over. ping me if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
